entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4663635816857326976 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/hv-12203/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12203: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 44902.6 +/- 2481.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 44902.6 +/- 2481.8 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax -0.0050 +/- 0.0378 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01), -0.1 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 1.563, 0.194 mas/yr. Radial velocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 4663635816857326976 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 10,000,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%204663635816857326976).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 24.8 +/- 1.4 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12203: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 24.8 +/- 1.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 17,253,360 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC3750, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4663635816857326976: 5 G-band harmonics of a 2.954142865582039 d period, peak-to-peak 0.521 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.01 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,750 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.06 +/- 0.004 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff0e9. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,750 K and log g 0.6 (u1 0.547, u2 0.152): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Unmeasured, bounded: no gravity of this star is published (none in SIMBAD); Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, table 3 (the spectroscopic gravities of its Cepheid spectra) gives the class's range, log g -1.33 to 2.86. Across log g 0 to 2.85, the part the grid covers, the limb laws differ by at most 2.4% of the centre brightness from the one drawn, at log g 0.6, the gravity closest to all of them; log g 0.6 is a display choice, not a measurement.
